origin: Own exact classical isotropic multicarrier Drude transport model in normalized charge, magnetic-field, density and mobility units, with |e|=1. The resistance and contact-voltage rows are constructed noiseless observables. No named real material or empirical carrier spectrum is claimed; quantum oscillations, field-dependent scattering and interaction corrections are outside this stipulated model.
transport_convention: Every carrier component has positive density n_i, strictly positive mobility mu_i, and sign s_i=+1(hole) or-1(electron). There are AT MOST THREE distinct nonzero mobility components, with all mobilities pairwise distinct, no zero-mobility component and no background conductivity. sigma_xx(B)=sum n_i*mu_i/(1+mu_i^2*B^2); sigma_xy(B)=sum s_i*n_i*mu_i^2*B/(1+mu_i^2*B^2). The conductivity tensor is [[sigma_xx,sigma_xy],[-sigma_xy,sigma_xx]]. Its inverse is the physical resistivity [[r,-h],[h,r]], where h=rho_yx=E_y/J_x under J_y=0. This stated convention fixes the Hall sign; an inverse-tensor offdiagonal cannot be relabeled without changing its sign.
measurement_and_assay: The CSV contains thirteen shuffled fields including zero and six exact +/-pairs. Its longitudinal value Rraw(B)=lambda*r(B), with one unknown positive shared geometric factor lambda. Its transverse value Hraw(B)=lambda*h(B)+kappa*Rraw(B)+c0, with unknown constant contact pickup kappa and additive offset c0. Rraw is even and the intrinsic Hall h is odd; use all field pairs and the zero row, and verify those parity assumptions from the source. A separate exact signed charge-density calibration gives sum s_i*n_i=2 in the SAME normalized units. This is signed hole-minus-electron density, not total absolute density, and is the only independent absolute-density information. Do not replace it with a single-band Hall density.
contact_and_tensor_reconstruction: Infer contact pickup and offset from the complete even-transverse versus longitudinal relation, retaining a full registered least-squares result using every distinct field magnitude including zero. Form each contact-corrected measured resistivity tensor from the actual odd Hall part and measured longitudinal resistance. Retain full registered matrix-inversion outputs at ALL seven nonnegative magnitudes. These are conductivities divided by the same unknown geometry, not already absolute conductivities. Numerical code may assemble tensors and parity pairs, but a scalar formula printed beside an answer is not the required full tensor observation.
complete_mobility_identification: Use x=B^2 and ALL seven reconstructed longitudinal conductivities. In the stated at-most-three-component family this is a proper rational function with numerator degree<=2 and denominator degree<=3, normalized to denominator constant 1. Retain a complete all-row least-squares/rational linear-system fit, including rank and residual. Derive the design from the measured conductivities; a nonlinear fit initialized near a guessed spectrum is not a completeness argument. Retain the COMPLETE denominator polynomial root inventory from a registered root solver before selecting real negative poles and positive mobilities. Check distinctness, positivity, no zero pole, no numerator cancellation and minimal model order. Prove uniqueness of the recovered full rational function within the declared finite family from the available distinct samples; do not assert global identifiability merely because an optimizer converged.
signed_spectrum_and_gauge: For each recovered mobility define the NORMALIZED Drude basis phi_i(x)=1/(1+mu_i^2*x), with x=B^2. Write measured conductivity divided by geometry as sigma_xx_measured(x)=sum A_i*phi_i(x) and sigma_xy_measured(B)/B=sum H_i*phi_i(B^2). The requested normalized Drude weights are A_i=n_i*mu_i/lambda and H_i=s_i*n_i*mu_i^2/lambda. Fit ALL seven longitudinal rows and ALL six nonzero-field Hall-over-B rows with registered full least-squares outputs in this exact basis. These weights differ from mathematical pole residues in the basis1/(x-p_i),p_i=-1/mu_i^2, which would instead be A_i/mu_i^2 and H_i/mu_i^2; pole residues are not requested. The ratios H_i/(mu_i*A_i) must equal the discrete charge signs +1 or -1, with every A_i positive. Recover densities divided by geometry, explain the COMPLETE positive scale gauge before using the external signed-density assay, then recover geometry and absolute densities. Arrays preserve ascending mobility order and the attached sign/density. Reconstruct every original raw resistance and contact-voltage row from the physical tensors and contact model.
continuous_Hall_and_magnetoresistance: Derive the exact physical r(B),h(B) responses and classify them over EVERY nonnegative field. Compute low- and high-field Hall slopes h/B, low-field single-band apparent signed density, and EVERY strictly positive Hall sign-reversal field with its complete polynomial root inventory and physical-domain filtering. The B=0 odd-function zero is not a strictly positive reversal. Compare low-field Hall sign with signed and total carrier density, explaining which mobility-weighted quantity is actually measured. Prove longitudinal monotonicity, determine whether a finite-field global maximum is attained, and give its global supremum, relative magnetoresistance supremum[r(B)-r(0)]/r(0), and high-field limit of r/B^2. A finite field grid cannot establish any of those global statements.
compensation_counterfactual: Change ONLY the recovered positive-hole density to exactly cancel the sum of electron densities; keep all inferred mobilities, both electron populations and charge conventions fixed. Derive the leading high-field coefficient of r_cf/B^2 and h_cf/B, checking the cancellation orders in conductivity BEFORE inversion. Compensation does not automatically imply zero Hall response. At B=2 retain a full registered inverse of this counterfactual conductivity tensor, then a registered product of its actual returned resistivity with current column[1,2]^T. Reportr_cf,h_cf,the resulting E vector and Joule power J dot E. Relate the full symmetric/antisymmetric tensor parts to passivity; a negative Hall sign is not negative longitudinal energy dissipation.
scope: All conclusions are conditional on the exact finite, field-independent classical carrier model and the stated contact/gauge assumptions. Large magnetoresistance, a Hall reversal, a conditional mobility spectrum and a true change in carrier number are different scientific claims. The counterfactual is a defined parameter change, not an observed field-driven transition or an assertion that every compensated material has these coefficients.

interpretation_proposals.A: Longitudinal contact pickup and an additive transverse offset can be separated from odd Hall transport by complete field-reversal data.
interpretation_proposals.B: The sign of a low-field Hall slope must equal the sign of hole-minus-electron number density in any multicarrier sample.
interpretation_proposals.C: A common unknown resistance geometry can leave absolute carrier density unidentified even when mobilities and charge signs are recovered.
interpretation_proposals.D: A positive Hall sign reversal requires carriers to be created or destroyed as the field changes.
interpretation_proposals.E: A large increasing magnetoresistance can saturate at high field without exact compensation.
interpretation_proposals.F: At exact compensation the high-field Hall slope must vanish.
interpretation_proposals.G: An antisymmetric Hall response with negative sign proves an active negative-dissipation material.
interpretation_proposals.H: Absolute-density calibration, complete rational-pole identification and high-field compensation asymptotics answer different parts of the transport question.

reporting: Use the public schema. Numeric tolerance1e-7absolute, exact counts/booleans/sign labels/proposal IDs. Mobility, sign, normalized Drude-weight and density arrays are paired in increasing mobility order. Denominator poles use x=B^2 and are sorted increasing. The Hall component is rho_yx throughout. Report physical normalized resistivities after geometry calibration, and explicitly distinguish limiting suprema from finite-field values. Full all-row fits, actual tensor inverses/products, all polynomial roots and continuous-domain/gauge arguments stay in the trajectory.

primary_context.title: Determination of electrical transport properties using a novel magnetic field-dependent Hall technique
primary_context.role: Primary mobility-spectrum context; publisher-deposited title/authors/date verified through Crossref. Publisher full text was not retrieved. The task states its own finite Drude family, exact observations, contact model and parameter changes; it does not reproduce or rely on a hidden article algorithm, figure or empirical dataset.
